discovery.english: Official Kedah results identify the Kuala Muda District and Land Office in Sungai Petani. A first-party municipal ArcGIS REST directory identifies a cadastral service with JUPEM NDCDB lot layers and JSON query support.
discovery.native: Malay-language official results identify JUPEM Kedah eKadaster and JUPEM eBiz digital cadastral-lot products. eKadaster has an authentication/agency boundary; eBiz is a product/purchase workflow, not a verified anonymous feature API.
